clock-sleep.message: test-audit clock: wait on the event or drive a controlled clock, never a fixed sleep (docs/testing.md)

clock-elapsed.message: test-audit clock: assert work done (calls, renders, rows), never elapsed time (docs/testing.md)

snapshot-runloop-sample.message: test-audit snapshot: sample a per-frame check right after each display commit (sampleCommittedLayouts(in:), UIUpdateLink .afterCATransactionCommit), never from a run-loop observer (docs/testing.md)

unheld-clock.message: test-audit unheld: fake the whole clock (vi.useFakeTimers({ now })) so real timers cannot run behind the test (docs/testing.md)

retry.message: test-audit defect loop: fix the cause; a retry hides a flaky test (docs/testing.md)

retry-config.message: test-audit defect loop: fix the cause; a retry hides a flaky test (docs/testing.md)

hosted-layout-loop.message: test-audit oversized: put each hosted layout that boots a new app fixture in its own test case (docs/testing.md)

heavy-commit-draw.message: test-audit heavy: force a commit with commitDisplay(of:) (two display updates), never with a drawing no one keeps; the simulator's render server snapshots the whole window for every drawing (docs/testing.md)
